tasks.title: Quarter-wave element length
tasks.statement: Frequency **{f} MHz**. Find the quarter wavelength in free space (mm).
tasks.solution: λ = c/f, a quarter is λ/4. On a real conductor the element is slightly shorter (velocity factor 0.95–0.97), which is why the antenna is trimmed by SWR.

tasks.title: Loss from rotating linear antennas
tasks.statement: Two linear antennas are rotated **{t}°** relative to each other. Find the polarization mismatch loss (dB).
tasks.solution: Received power ∝ cos²θ, loss = −20·lg(cos θ). 45° gives 3 dB, 90° is infinite in theory, 20+ dB in practice. Circular polarization removes this dependence on bank angle.
